_comment: The namespaces of the libraries under src/. libraries: each library with public headers (src/<library>/include/iclforge/<library>/) and the names under iclforge its headers may open; check_namespaces.py fails a header that opens another, and a header that declares into iclforge itself. debts: a header that declares into the root today, with the reason; the change that moves its declarations deletes the row.

debts.reason: BitReader is declared in iclforge itself, and every reader of a bitstream names it iclforge::BitReader: iclforge::base::BitReader is a change to each of them, and S6 changes the AC-3 library's names only
BitWriter is declared in iclforge itself, as BitReader is: moving it into iclforge::base changes each of its users
dft512 and kDftLength are declared in iclforge itself, and the AC-3 transforms name them iclforge::dft512: moving them into iclforge::dsp is a change to each of those
